goal: Establish strict deterministic compatibility contracts for an intent-compiled ephemeral spatial workspace, with explicit parse-bind-admit trust states and a sanitized projection over the canonical V1 manifest.
positive_requirements: Verify AURA_EPHEMERAL_ORGAN_V1 once, then derive a sanitized non-operational manifest projection reference without replacing the source manifest.
Separate bounded parsing from independently bound recipe admission.
Require lossless JSON canonicalization, single-snapshot hostile-input detachment, and non-empty serialized record digests.
Retain only closed scalar metadata and exact references to canonical truth owners.
Require the canonical Unified Memory and Continuity owner during project parsing.
Delegate source-path denial to aura_ephemeral_path_policy instead of duplicating a local secret-path policy.
Freeze CODING_SPATIAL_WORKSPACE_V1 capabilities, graph, handoff owners, gates, actions, lifecycle, and dissolution policy.
Publish Draft 2020-12 structural schemas plus named mandatory semantic validators.
Cover every accepted external review finding and every rejected overbroad assumption with regression evidence.
negative_requirements: Do not modify or replace the existing V1 manifest, Spatial, Compass, Forge, memory, runtime, renderer, or path-policy owners.
Do not create a project database, persistence store, second router, second renderer, second verifier, second path-policy plane, or second execution plane.
Do not treat self-consistent hashing or parsing as independent authority admission.
Do not coerce malformed keys, text, numbers, sets, digests, Git identities, custom mappings, or custom sequences into valid records.
Do not retain unknown, nested, authority-bearing, or raw-sensor metadata.
Do not grant patch, execution, persistence, deployment, physical-work, payment, professional, model, sensor, renderer, commit, push, pull-request, or merge authority.
Do not regenerate or retain CODEMAP/topology changes in this substantive PR.

allowed_path_set_digest_derivation.serialization: UTF-8 paths joined with newline characters plus one trailing newline

exit_gates: Existing V1 manifest object and digest remain unchanged when projected.
Live or custom manifest inputs are exported and detached exactly once.
Serialized V1 manifest content is independently recomputed and verified.
Workspace authority is derived from a sanitized manifest projection rather than the complete legacy grant/UI surface.
Every serialized new record requires and verifies its original 64-character digest.
Unknown metadata, non-string keys, sets, malformed types, recursion, lying container lengths, and raw-sensor aliases fail closed.
Project parsing requires the canonical continuity owner.
Recipe semantic admission requires a complete independently trusted expected recipe.
Recipe TTL and wall-time budget cannot outlive the source V1 manifest.
All schemas meta-validate and name mandatory semantic validators for cross-field invariants.
Generated navigation artifacts are identical to the exact base.
